_meta.description: Domain-specific rules for Tansaku intake analysis. Edit to match your project.

facts: All reports come from internal team members, never external customers directly.
All issues refer to the production environment unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Do not ask about the environment — assume production.

never_ask: Which environment does this occur in?
Can you try clearing the cache?
exceptions: Asking about cache is acceptable when the issue involves an external OAuth/SSO connection (e.g. DocuSign, SSO iframe).

fix_strategy.below_threshold: Implement the systemic fix now AND fix this specific case immediately.
fix_strategy.above_threshold: Apply a quick workaround for this case now AND open a new ticket for the systemic fix.
